1. Rent
The tenant pays monthly rent of INR 24000 on the fifth day of each month.

Either party may terminate after the first six months by giving 45 days of written notice.

A calendar entry does not change an express contractual date or extend a notice period. Neither attendance nor absence at a coordination meeting changes a payment obligation. Any request for a commercial change must be considered under the separate written amendment provision.

11. Transfers
The tenant must obtain the landlord's prior written consent before subletting any part of the premises.

12. Record format
Administrative records may be kept as searchable text or PDF. Scanned copies should be legible and page numbering should be retained where practicable. Contacts may request further supporting materials before replying. The administrative escalation route is distinct from any formal dispute-resolution procedure. Silence on an operational email is not acceptance of a proposed amendment, waiver of an obligation or agreement to a new commercial term.

Proposed amendments must identify the provision to be changed and the replacement text. Draft revisions should be marked clearly so that both parties can compare versions. A negotiation draft is not effective merely because it is circulated, discussed or stored in the shared folder. The parties must follow the agreement's execution requirements for an amendment.
